decision_rules.full_interaction_harms_forecast: paired full-minus-none squared-error 95% interval lower bound is above zero
decision_rules.full_interaction_improves_forecast: paired full-minus-none squared-error 95% interval upper bound is below zero
decision_rules.no_detectable_difference: paired full-minus-none squared-error 95% interval contains zero

hypotheses.context_methods: Uniform independent-candidate averaging and the known-true candidate are descriptive references.
hypotheses.negative_results_reported: Report improvement, harm, or no detectable difference separately at 1, 3, and 7 days without changing the rule after seeing results.
hypotheses.primary_question: At each lead, does full-interaction assimilation improve the corrected forecast relative to no-interaction assimilation?
